judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing its planning document (`.lore/dod.md`), acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrows.acceptance.test.ts`), and partial spec additions, without ever implementing the actual fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `beforeSession` is still awaited outside the `try` block, the newly added acceptance tests will fail. Additionally, the candidate did not remove the obsolete flaw line from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (so the spec now contradicts itself) and did not update `CHANGELOG.md`. Although the candidate's `.lore/dod.md` accurately identified every required change, almost none of the implementation steps were executed.
